test_nested_modules: test that nested pybind11 modules have correct __name__ attributes and submodule functions work
test_reference_internal: test internal reference handling between pybind11 classes A and B including copy assignments
test_importing: test that pybind11 modules can import and expose Python stdlib types like OrderedDict

test_duplicate_registration: test that duplicate registration of names in pybind11 modules returns an empty list
